defects.summary: Python에서 같은 1과 True를 저장 레코드에서 교체하면 스키마 검사를 생략하거나 부모 JSON 바이트를 재사용하여 요청한 형과 바이트를 잃는다.
defects.found_by: 보존/수리판에서 발견한 원 결함을 main의 기존 코드에서도 직접 재현했다. do-math-tests-vya2yx6q에서 b'1\n' != b'true\n'와 boolean 스키마의 integer 교체에 ValueError 미발생으로 두 검사가 실패했다.
defects.missed_kind: Python 값 동등성의 왕복만으로 boolean/integer를 구별하지 못했다. canonical.same_json_value를 부모 스키마 검사 생략과 인코더 바이트 재사용이 공유한다. 실제 새 Repository 적재의 정확한 형/바이트, 부모 검사 반려와 상태 전문 보존, 봉인 문자열/중첩 값의 정규 바이트 동등성, 변경 없는 부모 재사용을 검사한다. main 관련 저장69개가 do-math-tests-dznmr7tc에서 통과했다.

defects.summary: file_io.os_lock(blocking=True) raises PermissionError at once instead of waiting when another opener has locked byte 0 of a lock file that was still empty when this caller checked its size
defects.found_by: 1a legacy run under three parallel bundles: test_research_recovery.RecoveryRoutingTests.test_concurrent_controls_receive_distinct_durable_order errored with PermissionError in os_lock; passed 3 of 3 when rerun alone
defects.missed_kind: No boundary test drove os_lock with two openers racing on a new lock file; the legacy concurrency test reaches the race only by timing

defects.summary: The executable identity of a command is normalized by several copies that differ: Path(shutil.which(x) or x).resolve() in codex_adapter (capability_identity, observation_key) and formal.verify_lean, resolve(strict=True) in formal.inspect_toolchain, no which in cli_execution.checked_start_paths, so one executable can compare unequal to itself between these checks
defects.found_by: 1e obligation 9-A (boundary static invariants): the executable-path comparison invariant fails on the current code
defects.missed_kind: No structure check required one normalization function for executable identity; each boundary module wrote its own

defects.summary: setup_lean.run starts Lean setup commands (elan, lake) with subprocess.run without creationflags, so a console window can open when the tool runs under a parent without a console
defects.found_by: 1e obligation 9-A: the console-flag invariant walked scripts/ as well as do_math/ and found this start
defects.missed_kind: The legacy scan (test_background_processes) walked only do_math/*.py, not the tools directly under scripts/

defects.summary: The control inbox reader (core_engine._inbox) raises out of the owner pass on a damaged inbox file (invalid JSON, not an object, an ID or instance other than its own, a missing ordering field) instead of rejecting it, and the file stays, so every later pass stops at the same file
defects.found_by: 1e obligation 2-A (ingress rejection contract): damaged inbox files injected into the owner pass on the Sim
defects.missed_kind: No test put a damaged file into the inbox; the public submit check shields the inbox from malformed payloads, so tests reached only payload-level rejection

defects.summary: ControlTransport.pump raises out of the owner pass when a delivery file is rewritten under a request ID it already rejected: the rejection path (_reject_delivery_file) itself raises 'request_id was already received with different content', and the file stays, so every later pump stops there
defects.found_by: 1e obligation 2-A: request ID collision and redelivery (the third input class) on the control transport's inbox
defects.missed_kind: Transport tests delivered each request ID once; no test rewrote a delivery after its rejection

defects.summary: FormalEngineMixin._apply_trust_rebind records the trust_environment_rebound lifecycle event with toolchain_record, previous, current and recorded_at, which the closed event schema rejects, so publishing after a toolchain rerecord rebinds stops on storage validation
defects.found_by: 1e obligation 1-A (storage-family pair): a census of lifecycle event calls against the closed event schema; the pair survey confirmed the storage checker rejects the four fields
defects.missed_kind: The legacy tests of the rebind (test_lifecycle_engine, test_machine_parallel) run on the StateStore double, which skips storage validation, and assert these fields as expected values

defects.summary: The observation tracker accepts any nonempty rule ID (observations.validate_rules), but a stored review row keeps rule_ids under the storage ID pattern, so an observation_unavailable row for a rule named with a space, a colon or non-ASCII letters is rejected on publication
defects.found_by: 1e obligation 1-C (value domains): the observation rule ID pair, tracker acceptance against the stored rule_ids check; the pair survey confirmed 'progress check'
defects.missed_kind: Rule fixtures used IDs such as R-1; no test fed the tracker's accepted domain to the stored schema

defects.summary: The condition grammar (planning.validate_condition) checks record_field_equals values only for /status and /lifecycle, so a condition on an enumerated field (formal-result /publication_state and /formal_use, identity-assessment /decision, execution /outcome) with a value outside the stored enumeration is accepted and can never hold
defects.found_by: 1e obligation 1-A: one pair per enumerated condition pointer, the grammar's accepted values against the stored enumeration (조사 C-25 form)
defects.missed_kind: The C-25 fix shared the lifecycle constants with the grammar; pointers without a lifecycle constant kept no value check and no test compared them with storage

defects.summary: A trust re-check that follows a re-recorded toolchain baseline cannot finish: its environment check rebinds the environment (FormalEngineMixin._apply_trust_rebind), the trust_environment_rebound event carries the four fields the closed event schema rejects (KD-0006), and the storage validation error raises out of the owner collection (ModelCalls.collect), so the re-check execution stays running, the transition records no result for the target and the transition cannot activate
defects.found_by: 1f migration of test_lifecycle_engine.LifecycleTests.test_rerecorded_baseline_is_followed_once_with_an_event onto the Sim: the same scenario on real storage
defects.missed_kind: The legacy test ran on FakeEngine, whose StateStore double records saves without storage validation, and asserted the rebound event fields as expected values (the KD-0006 defect)

defects.summary: A queued trust re-check pinned to a trust_check profile edition that is no longer adopted is never dispatched: the lifecycle gate's profile selection refuses the pinned edition ("profile selection must resolve to exactly one permitted role/model edition"), _dispatchable records that as a lifecycle dispatch wait and keeps the action queued while the instance reports ready, so the transition stays checking, which blocks formal admission and any new transition. A re-check stopped by a pause keeps the edition its gate pinned, so pausing it, configuring another Lean command and resuming reaches this state; the attempt is expected to end without the verifier instead
defects.found_by: 1f migration of test_lifecycle_engine.LifecycleBoundaryTests.test_wrong_pinned_trust_command_ends_attempt_without_verifier onto the Sim with the owner pass instead of FakeEngine's own profile selection
defects.missed_kind: FakeEngine replaced _execution_profile with a copy of the selection rule that accepts any pinned profile reference, so the legacy test reached the trust re-check steps the real gate never reaches

defects.summary: Any control that arrives while an external action begins its send steps cancels the effect: ExternalEngineMixin._run_external_action gives the operation a new execution_id before the execution is registered, the external stop judgment then applies the inbox (core_engine._apply_inbox) and publishes, the storage check refuses the operation's reference to the unregistered execution ("external_operations references unknown record"), and that error cancels the operation as a failure before sending, even for a control unrelated to it (a new grant) that requests no stop
defects.found_by: 1f migration of test_lifecycle_engine.LifecycleTests.test_failure_before_any_send_step_is_an_untransmitted_cancellation onto the Sim: a control delivered at the first inbox read of the send steps on real storage
defects.missed_kind: The legacy tests ran the send steps on FakeEngine, whose _save records copies without storage validation, and made controls arrive by replacing _apply_inbox, which never published

defects.summary: The trust activation that a finished trust re-check queues (FormalEngineMixin._trust_check_steps, _enqueue('trust_activate', transition_id=...)) carries no source_ref, so its execution record names no source, while the activation the transition control queues for an empty transition carries the control as its source: the two places that queue the same action differ
defects.found_by: 1f migration of test_lifecycle_engine.GrantAndExternalEffectTests.test_machine_records_use_registered_schema_and_existing_source_provenance: running its provenance check also over a transition activated after its re-checks
defects.missed_kind: The legacy provenance test activated only an empty transition, whose activation the control queues, and ran the re-checks of a second transition without activating it; the execution schema does not require source_ref

defects.summary: Preparing an impact review reads the held producer's sealed submission (call_engine._prepare_call -> core_engine._context), and an unreadable one raises out of the owner pass: a SealedSubmissionError (hash or receipt mismatch) ends the review attempt start_failed and is raised again from run while the review action stays queued (_continue_prepared_action), so every later pass prepares, fails and stops at the same action; a GitStateStoreError (missing object) is caught by no handler on that path. The retry path (_retry_impact_reviews) holds the same condition as a submission_failure wait, but it reads the bytes only after the review ended, so a submission unreadable before its review never reaches that hold
defects.found_by: 1f knowledge.2 (impact_review migration): a held producer's sealed output changed in the repository before its impact review was prepared, on the Sim; confirmed by the strength review's code trace
defects.missed_kind: No test made a held submission unreadable before its review started: the legacy retry test replaced read_sealed_submission only around the retry, and the review's own preparation read ran only on readable bytes. In the reproduction a missing object is stopped earlier by the owner's pre-write presence and length inspection (_inspect_before_write), so the uncaught GitStateStoreError branch is known from the code, not run

defects.summary: A charter decision that changes only the academic requirements, applied through the public control after the goal was solved, un-solves the goal: the engine's goal-currentness check (knowledge_engine._invalidate_goal_currentness) compares each current goal judgment's goal_revision with the governance view's goal_revision, which is the charter revision, so any new charter edition marks the judgments stale ('The actual judgment basis changed'), sets goal_status unsolved and leaves no solution basis, and the academic follow-up generates no task for the new requirements. The governance rule keeps the goal solved for an academic-only change (governance._apply_domain_decision, academic_only) and the solution basis leaves the requirements out of its goal reference (academic.current_solution_basis), so two copies of one rule disagree. The check runs in two places, and a repair must cover both: after every extended control (lifecycle_engine._apply_extended_control, lifecycle_engine.py 448) and in every owner pass's readiness refresh (lifecycle_engine._refresh_readiness, lifecycle_engine.py 581, which scheduler.py 161 calls each pass), so a requirement change applied without the control step is un-solved at the next pass too. Besides the reproduction, the four moved requirement-change tests' public-control versions (sim.test_academic_requirement_changes.AcademicRequirementChangeTests) carry this mark
defects.found_by: 1f academic.1 (test_academic_engine migration): the requirement-change tests moved onto a goal the configured goal auditors solved on the Sim; the first public requirement change after the solution left the goal unsolved
defects.missed_kind: The legacy requirement-change tests set goal_status directly with no goal judgments and patched the engine's _solution_basis to a constant, so the currentness check had no judgment to mark stale and the basis never changed; the pure governance test applied the decision without the engine's control step Independent main repair: mathematical_goal_basis is shared by domain charter decisions, judgment production/currentness, queued audit basis and academic solution basis. The actual main red do-math-tests-htvtby_s leaves the goal unsolved after an academic-only public decision. Current tests check public/direct-rule owner refresh, exact judgments and solution basis across restart.

defects.summary: scheduled_operator의 두 자식 호출을 공유 Job으로 전환한 뒤 외부 spawn/wait 오류의 원 예외형·메시지가 소실된다. 407db136의 subprocess.run은 FileNotFoundError/OSError 원형을 전달하지만 formal._worker는 worker_error와 traceback만 저장하고 _job_run은 RuntimeError로 바꾼다. run_engine result.error와 recovery execution.error.type/message가 달라진다. main의 evidence_dir/decode_errors 교정 뒤에도 이 경로는 같다.
defects.found_by: operator-audit 전체 행동 대조 및 operator-fix-first-report.json(2026-10-01, 49.6초). 원 subprocess.run을 존재하지 않는 executable로 호출하여 받은 FileNotFoundError를 실제 formal worker의 외부 spawn 경계에 그대로 주입했다. engine/recovery 두 소비자 모두 RuntimeError를 기록해 마지막 전체 오류 목록 비교에서 실패했다. 최초 실패 보고서와 failure JSON 보존.
defects.missed_kind: 기존 operator 이행 시험은 정상 stdout/stderr/exit와 scheduler 오류만 관찰했으며, 공유 worker가 바꾼 원 child 생성 예외형을 비교하지 않았다. 시험은 원 동작을 기대하고 새 오류를 정답으로 고정하지 않는다.; corrected during stage-1 integration: the new shared worker now transports checked OSError facts for the two operator callers, preserving the original exception class/message. The reproduction remains unmarked as regression; Lean retains its original worker_error contract.

defects.summary: An accepted empty initial preparation starts one research_plan worker despite having no tasks, returned results or preparation requests to decide; three further owner passes observe preparation=1 and plan=1 instead of 11-A's plan=0.
defects.found_by: Cross obligations on main-wip snapshot e440bf7: real Sim activation, accepted empty provider submission, model call log and actual Jobs worker request IDs; cross-initial.log reproduced the unexpected research_plan call. Setup, accepted outcomes and request/call correspondence are checked outside expectedFailure.
defects.missed_kind: flows.test_scheduling_parallel_engine.PlanOpeningTests.test_preparation_without_any_pending_review_still_opens_a_plan pins the empty-plan enqueue as expected; no targetless model/Job zero-count assertion covered the subsequent owner passes.
